scope: Read-only independent audit of current reconciliation script/report, six rebound part records, six preserved initial parent records, both followup inspection records, current source/PDF/PNG files and preserved initial PDF/PNG files. limitations: Inspection records are trusted reviewer attestations: hashing establishes artifact identity and pixel equivalence, not whether an observer actually viewed an image. I independently witnessed and authored the two original parts attributed to me; the remaining parts and fresh pages are attested by the assigned reviewers.
This is layout-coverage reconciliation, not biological interpretation, numerical provenance or a formal Lean proof.
Inherited caption splits, publication placeholders and contents/page-number limitations remain bounded observations; coverage does not assert flawless global typography.
Source or rendered-file changes after the audited identities require another validated reconciliation or fresh inspection.
